scope: Generation and packaging worker visual QA only; manager visual acceptance and browser validation pending. Appearance is visual only.
styleAssessment: The normalized batch matches the accepted v6a/v6b compact head/body proportions, dark stepped contours, large eye rendering, muted clothing palette and smooth cel shading in worker visual judgment. Inspected all 39 initial native generation outputs, all 152 final normalized poses on five dark sheets, the 19-identity overview, eight identical-scale v6b/v6c pairs, all six full-catalog inventory boards, all 19 same-band and 19 all-catalog nearest-six boards, all 76 final seated contact lines and all 19 south-facing chair proofs. Older identities use silver/white hair, thinning patterns, modest age lines and varied civilian wardrobes without diagnosis associations. No unresolved duplicate or pose-consistency concern found. Manager acceptance remains pending. Manager subsequently accepted the other 18 identities and requested only .018 regeneration for adult readability. Reviewed both new native .018 outputs and all eight final normalized .018 poses; its adult face/stubble, broader shoulders and full-length trousers match the accepted compact style. Other accepted identities are pinned byte-for-byte by a revision baseline. Original QA notes are preserved in analysis/018-regeneration.

glassesAssessment.method: Visual inspection of all eight final poses for every identity, independently recorded from planned roster fields.

limitations: Artistic equivalence cannot be established by geometry or RMSE. The accepted v6a/v6b anchor follows recent v3/v4/v5 art; earlier gs018 catalog art remains grainier and is included without changing normalization.

017's targeted east-profile hair correction is slightly smoother at full native source size. At the normalized 160x320 scale its contour weight, head/body proportion and shading remain consistent in worker judgment; manager should inspect 017 closely. Its shaved side is anatomical left, visible in west profiles and covered by the long bob on east profiles.

Draped garment contacts, especially skirts 002, 004 and 007, are source-bound worker estimates of support beneath the pelvis rather than hem-bottom measurements. All four directions are shown; only the approved south-facing Front Desk chair geometry has a placement proof. Cane and hearing aids are visual only and do not set support coordinates.
Stylized faces do not prove exact ages. Intended age and compatible sex remain explicit assigned-band metadata; no clinical meaning or appearance-selection weighting was added.

Only alpha-1 native fringe noise occurs outside normalized footprints or on output borders. No protected alpha is clipped and no source pixels were repainted. Explicit manager acceptance of this exact alpha report remains pending.
Browser gallery validation is left to the manager as requested. Worker validation checks static links and PNG decoding only; no browser, game origin or campaign storage was accessed.

018's native regeneration retains the original standing sheet as a historical seed and a byte-exact original in history; the active eight-pose adult source supersedes the old shorts/bowl-cut appearance. Manager review of the regenerated .018 remains pending; the other 18 identities were accepted in the manager's request.
